plugin.name: Command Code
plugin.description: Command Code's models for the agent, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds Command Code to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from Command Code, so new models show up by themselves.
config.apiKey.title: Command Code API key
config.apiKey.description: From Command Code Studio → Settings → API Keys, on the Provider plan. Claude models are only served through Command Code's own protocol and aren't listed.
